hooks.name: Related tests on save
hooks.description: When a file in src/ is saved, run the Vitest tests related to it and report failures.

action.prompt: A file in src/ was just saved. Run only the Vitest tests related to it, from the project root, in one-shot mode: `npx vitest related --run <saved file path>` (if the saved file is a .css or .html file, also run `npx vitest run src/no-inline.test.ts`). If every test passes, say so in one line with the test count. If any test fails, report each failure: test name, file, the assertion message, and for fast-check failures the seed and the counterexample. Do not change any code because of this hook; only report.
